source.document: Ford and Lincoln ADAS Job Aid (CPR 11/2021)
source.note: Always refer to the Ford Workshop Manual for the specific vehicle.

general_requirements: Driver assist systems are calibrated for the vehicle as designed. Any aftermarket alteration could cause a system to malfunction or not accept a correct calibration.

components.component: Lane Keeping Camera (Image Processing Module A / IPMA)
components.location: Top edge of the windshield, below the interior rear view mirror
components.calibration_note: Lane keeping systems are calibrated based on the manufacturer's specified ride height and wheel/tire combinations. If ride height or wheels have been altered, this will affect system accuracy.
triggers: Windshield is removed for structural repairs that affect windshield position

components.component: Cruise Control Module and Radar Sensor
components.location: Behind the front bumper cover, in an opening in the front fascia or bumper behind an unpainted plastic cover
triggers: Vehicle has been in an accident
Sensor is removed from the vehicle for access
Bracket support in which the sensor is mounted is removed from the vehicle for access

components.location: Center of front grille, below center emblem
triggers: Any camera is replaced or removed from the vehicle
Camera or any body component the camera is attached to is removed or adjusted

components.location: Tailgate on pickups, rear decklid on passenger cars, liftgate on SUVs
triggers: Any camera is replaced or removed from the vehicle
Camera or any body component the camera is attached to is removed or adjusted

components.component: 360 Degree Camera - LH and RH Side
components.location: Underside of LH and RH exterior rear view mirrors
triggers: Camera is replaced or removed from the vehicle
Outside rearview mirror is removed, adjusted, or replaced

components.location: Four sensors along the front bumper and four sensors along the rear bumper
Front bumper on each side of the vehicle
